title: Hidden Agent folders
hide: Hide Agent sessions in {path} on {machine} from Agents and Persona's view (they keep running and stay recorded; active supervised tasks stay visible)
add_off: Add hidden folder {path} on {machine}, switched off (nothing is hidden until you switch it on)
switch_on: Switch on hidden folder {path} on {machine} (its sessions leave Agents and Persona's view)
switch_off: Switch off hidden folder {path} on {machine} (its sessions show again; the rule stays)
remove: Delete hidden folder {path} on {machine} (its sessions show again)
